description:
EDA (Energiewirtschaftliches Datenaustausch) integration for Energy Community
v2 tenants (EnergyCommunity 4.x + Basic.Energy 1.2.x, stream-data storage for
metering values — ADR 0001, AB#4550).

Installs:
- EDA adapter (System.Communication/Adapter) — deployed via Communication Operator,
  AdapterConfiguration skeleton with empty credentials (fill in Refinery Studio before deploy)
- 15 EDA pipelines in 8 DataFlows: receive-eda-messages, handle-daten-crmsg,
  request-all-metering-points, request-consumption-reports,
  request-missing-consumption-reports, energy-set-states-depending-on-meteringpoints
  each keep their own DataFlow; start-eda-process carries two (the HTTP endpoint
  and `Start planned EDA processes`, 2.2.1); the seven process-message handlers (EC_REQ_ONL,
  EC_PODLIST, EC_PRTFACT_CHANGE, CR_REQ_PT, CM_REV_SP, CM_REV_CUS, CM_REV_IMP)
  share the DataFlow `eda-handle-process-messages` (6a3ba517dd34215646b7a8a4,
  AB#4820) and carry their process name on the Pipeline itself. All seven run
  on FromPolling@1 with staggered intervals (2:05 / 2:55 / 3:10 / 3:35 / 4:20 /
  5:00 / 5:40) so they never poll the EDA adapter in lockstep;
  FromExecutePipelineCommand@1 stays in each definition, commented out, as the
  manual fallback. handle-daten-crmsg is the exception: it stays on
  FromExecutePipelineCommand@1 with its FromPolling@1 (00:00:35) commented
  out — the stream-data ingest is driven on demand, not by a 35-second poll
- 1 System.Communication/PipelineTrigger: `request-all-metering-points`
  (69e1b8a1870f4f0d6e91e630) fires its pipeline daily at 04:00 via cron
  (`0 0 4 * * *`) instead of an explicit ExecutePipelineCommand — ported from
  the energy-community-deployment reference, hence the new System.Bot
  dependency (System.Bot/CronExpression)
- `Start planned EDA processes` (6a2bc26a6830b2865f042892) starts EdaProcess
  entities flagged Planned once their StartTime is due; Sender/Receiver are
  already set by the HTTP pipeline when the process is created, so the update
  step leaves them untouched (ported from energy-community-deployment, 2.2.1)
- 16 EDA-internal queries (process tracking, metering-point lookups,
  participation periods, planned processes)
- EDA cockpit MeshBoard (System.UI/Dashboard `energy-community-eda` +
  widgets, AB#4578): metering-point count KPI, state donut, and two
  EdaProcess tables (errored: success==false / open: finished==false) over a
  new SimpleRtQuery on Basic.Energy/EdaProcess. Requires the service-managed
  System.UI CK model (octo-platform-services running).

EC v2 changes vs. the 1.x line:
- handle-daten-crmsg writes 15-minute stream data: ParseConsumptionRecord@1 ->
  Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement anchor entities (well-known name
  <meteringPointRtId>_<obisCode>, deduped via UpdateRtEntityIfNewer@1) ->
  SaveTimeRangeStreamDataInArchive@1 into the Base 2.x raw archive
  energy-measurements (ec0000000000000000000a01). No more per-interval
  EnergyQuantity entities and no overlap delete/insert reconciliation.
- All pipelines and queries use the v2 types directly: Basic.Energy/EdaMessage,
  EdaProcess, EdaMeteringPoint, MeteringPoint, OperatingFacility and the
  Basic.Energy/MessageToProcess association. EnergyCommunity/Consumer,
  Producer, Customer and ParticipationPeriod remain EnergyCommunity types.
- request-consumption-reports and request-missing-consumption-reports are
  installed as safe no-ops: their gap/quality detection queried
  EnergyCommunity/EnergyQuantity and moves to stream-data queries with
  AB#4551 (see the TODO(AB#4551) markers in the pipeline definitions).

Prerequisites:
- EnergyCommunity.Base 2.x installed (provides the energy-measurements
  stream-data archives; activate them before deploying the EDA data flows)

Post-install:
- Fill AdapterConfiguration JSON (EdaHttpAdapter.Host, User, Password, IsSimulationMode)
  on the EDA adapter entity in Refinery Studio
- octo-cli -c DeployWorkload -id 686e0f17196fcd3c42ed8c77   # EDA adapter
- DeployTriggers activates the cron trigger of request-all-metering-points
  (it ships DeploymentState 0 like every other EDA entity)
- DeployDataFlow per DataFlow — pipelines are pre-assigned to the EDA adapter
  via Executes-1, no manual assignment needed. One call covers all seven
  process handlers:
  octo-cli -c DeployDataFlow --identifier 6a3ba517dd34215646b7a8a4

Upgrading a tenant from 2.1.x (AB#4820):
- The seven per-handler DataFlows were removed from the seed. Removing them
  from the seed does NOT delete them on an installed tenant — run
  `UndeployDataFlow` on each, then
  `octo-cli -c UpdateBlueprint -tv EnergyCommunity.EdaIntegration-2.2.0 -m Full`
  (preview it first — the delete is a permanent Erase). See README.md.

2.4.0 splits the seed across one file per topic (AB#4758 `seedDataPaths`) —
identical entities, no data change. It therefore requires an engine that knows
`seedDataPaths`: an older engine drops the unknown property, finds no
`seedDataPath` and installs an EMPTY seed while still reporting success.
Install 2.3.1 on such tenants.
